## Validation

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private data, or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Browser permissions remain no broader than required.
- [ ] Network access remains limited to loopback addresses.
- [ ] New dependencies, containers, scripts, and executable downloads were reviewed.
- [ ] The change does not add telemetry, remote logging, or untrusted runtime code.
